contents.text: How much notice stops the Fabrikam Seals contract from renewing?

Either party may end the agreement for material breach that is not remedied within 30 days of written notice. The contract runs from July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2027 and renews for one year unless either party gives notice 90 days before it ends.

Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals › 6 Termination
## 6 Termination
Either party may end the agreement for material breach that is not remedied within 30 days of written notice.
Orders placed before termination are delivered on the agreed terms.

Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals
# Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals
Contoso Industrial and Fabrikam Seals agree on the supply of mechanical seals for CP-200 pumps: PN-4471-B and, from September 2026, PN-4471-C.
The contract runs from July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2027 and renews for one year unless either party gives notice 90 days before it ends.
Fabrikam Seals delivers within six weeks of an order and reports any quality incident that affects delivered parts within five business days.

Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals › 4 Quality
## 4 Quality
The supplier keeps an ISO 9001 certified quality system and supplies a certificate of conformity with every delivery.
The buyer may audit the supplier's plant with ten business days' notice.

Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals › 2 Products and prices
## 2 Products and prices
Schedule A: products and prices
| Part number | Description | Unit price | Minimum order |
|---|---|---|---|
| PN-4471-B | Cartridge mechanical seal for CP-200 (until September 13, 2026) | 1,180 USD | 4 |
| PN-4471-C | Cartridge mechanical seal for CP-200, silicon-carbide face | 1,340 USD | 4 |
Prices are fixed for the first 12 months and may then rise by no more than the producer price index for industrial seals, once a year, with 60 days' notice.
